summary.plain: A group of mountaintop telescopes in the Chilean Andes, long the main US platform for studying the southern sky. Its 4-metre Blanco telescope carries the Dark Energy Camera.
summary.technical: NSF NOIRLab observatory on Cerro Tololo, Chile, at about 2200 m, operating since 1965; operates the 4-m Víctor M. Blanco telescope with DECam, used for the Dark Energy Survey.
